title: The One Skill That 10x'd My Income (It's Not What You'd Expect)
script: Everyone says learn to code. Everyone says learn sales. Here's the skill that nobody talks about that 10x'd my income — and it is not technical. It is clear written communication. Not emails. The ability to clearly articulate value in writing. This skill compounds faster than any technical skill because every message you send either builds or costs you credibility. One clear Slack message gets you the promotion over the person who explains things in a meeting. One clear proposal gets you the client over the person with better slides. One clear LinkedIn post gets you noticed over the person with better credentials. The difference between a junior and senior version of any role is usually not skill — it is clarity. How to start building it this week: before any important message you send, ask one question — can someone who does not know me understand exactly what I am offering and what I want? If yes, you have done it. If no, rewrite it. Every message is a credibility deposit. Start making them.
